Gautam Adani Tops Hurun Rich List 2026, India's Billionaires Rise

Gautam Adani and his family have regained the top position on the M3M Hurun India Rich List for 2026. The list indicates that India's count of dollar billionaires has reached a new record of 391. The artificial intelligence (AI) sector has emerged as a significant area for wealth creation, contributing 15 new individuals to the list. The coverage also notes that Dubai is attracting India's top new wealth creators.
